kurtosis.root_cause: AR accumulates 30 small Gaussian deltas -> CLT -> low kurtosis. One-shot preserves heavy tails.

cointegration.finding: AR preserves long-run equilibrium (ratio near 1.0); one-shot loses it (ratio ~0.32)

coverage.finding: 133c has much better coverage (91.7% vs 65.5%); 140a severely under-spread

conditionality.finding: Both conditional; 133c much stronger MAE reduction

architectural_implications.for_kurtosis: One-shot generation essential; AR sums -> CLT kills heavy tails
architectural_implications.for_cointegration: AR structure essential; one-shot loses cell-cell equilibrium
architectural_implications.for_step3_cln: Need hybrid: either AR with non-Gaussian innovations, or one-shot with cointegration loss
architectural_implications.tradeoff: Suite 4 (kurtosis) and Suite 6 (cointegration) appear structurally opposed between AR and one-shot
